name: Google Calendar

tiers.how: Sage reads and writes calendar events through the Google Calendar API (scope calendar.events) via `assistant/agent/google_api.py`. The owner must complete the OAuth consent flow once; the refresh token is stored in the OS credential store. The same token covers Gmail and Calendar. Creating or modifying events always requires an approval card.

gotchas: The same OAuth token covers Calendar and Gmail; revoking one revokes both.
Sage uses Calendar as the authoritative source for shoot-date availability checks before any booking confirmation.
Always confirm with the owner before adding a client shoot date; double-booking is irreversible.
Token refresh is automatic but requires the process to have network access.
notes: Google Calendar is the single source of truth for booked dates and shoot-day timelines; always check it before confirming availability.
